## Clipper 6.4.2.2 (`clipper.js`), Boost Software License 1.0

`clipper.js` is the npm release clipper-lib 6.4.2 (`clipper.js`; Angus
Johnson's Clipper, translated to JavaScript by Timo), turned into an ES
module: the UMD wrapper is replaced by `export default`, the browser sniffing
that picks between equivalent big-integer fast paths is fixed to one choice,
and the `window.Int128` global is removed. `clipper.d.ts` declares the parts
the cores use. Nothing else is changed.

